The '''''Harthusa's Pride''''' was a modified space yacht owned by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]], [[Harthusa]]. Confiscated by agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in the [[Bissillirus system/Legends|Bissillirus system]] shortly after the liberation of [[Kentara]], they kept the ship as they continued to investigate the [[Bissillirus Resupply Base]]

==Description==
''Harthusa's Pride'' was a [[Luxurious-class space yacht|''Luxurious''-class space yacht]] manufactured by [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]]. Thirty-one [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long,<ref name="Enslaved-CC" /> the ship had cargo capacity to store seventy-five [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] within thirty [[Cubic meter/Legends|cubic meters]] of space,<ref name="Enslaved" /> and one [[Standard month/Legends|month's]] worth of consumables. The ship was extensively modified by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] [[Harthusa]] to his specifications, and reflected his own personal creed, which was to run rather than fight. ''Harthusa's Pride'' was fast for a vessel of its class, capable of achieving speeds of 1,200 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] and [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]]. Its [[Hull/Legends|hull]] and [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] were relatively weak, and could only withstand a few hits. Likewise, its armament was a single [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. However, the vessel was installed with a [[sensor stealth package]] that made the ''Harthusa's Pride'' difficult to detect.<ref name="Enslaved-CC" />

The ship was equipped with a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] and [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], and a Class Two [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]<ref name="Enslaved" /> with a Class Twelve backup unit. A crew of one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and one [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] operated the vessel, and four passengers were able to be transported comfortably in the luxurious appointed staterooms with carpeted corridors and expensive statuary. Harthusa also maintained a private master suite stocked with [[Alcohol/Legends|liquors]] and [[Spice/Legends|spices]]. The cargo hold was fitted out to contain cells to contain up to thirty cells. After its modifications, the ''Harthusa's Pride'' cost 350,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Enslaved-CC" />

==History==
The ''Harthusa's Pride'' was Harthusa's base of operations as he plied his slave trade around the galaxy.<ref name="Enslaved" /> Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Dating">[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Heggel]]'s entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' states that he took command of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Not long after this, the [[Bissillirus Resupply Base]] is constructed, a process that only takes fourteen [[Standard day/Legends|days]].</ref> the ''Harthusa's Pride'' was appropriated by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives after they raided Harthusa's [[Slave camp|compound]] on [[Deysum III]] and freed the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Kentara]], a fellow Rebel that Harthusa had sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].<ref name="Enslaved" />
